_note: Calibration set for the judge. Each reference reply was written to meet the criterion from the knowledge base; each defective copy has one planted defect. Labels are known by construction, not collected from people.

replies.reference: An 'invalid audience' error means the Entity ID set in your new identity provider doesn't match the one shown under Settings > SSO. Copy the Entity ID and the ACS URL from Settings > SSO into the new IdP exactly, and upload the new IdP's signing certificate.
replies.defective: To export invoices in bulk, go to Billing > Invoices, filter by date range and choose Export > PDF archive.

replies.reference: Yes. Go to Billing > Invoices, filter the date range to 2025 and choose Export > PDF archive. If the archive holds more than 500 invoices, we email you a download link instead.
replies.defective: Yes. Go to Billing > Invoices, filter the date range to 2025 and choose Export > PDF archive. If the archive holds more than 100 invoices, we email you a download link instead.

replies.reference: After a rotation, the old and new secrets both stay valid for 24 hours. A 401 from your endpoint usually means your receiver still checks the old secret, or computes the signature over a modified body. Check that the receiver uses the new secret and signs the raw request body.
replies.defective: After a rotation, the old and new secrets both stay valid for 24 hours. A 401 from your endpoint usually means your receiver still checks the old secret. We'll also redeliver every failed event for you automatically by the end of today.

replies.reference: We retry a failed delivery 8 times with exponential backoff, over about 24 hours. After the last retry the event is marked failed, and you can redeliver it from the dashboard.
replies.defective: We retry a failed delivery 5 times with exponential backoff, over about 12 hours. After the last retry the event is marked failed, and you can redeliver it from the dashboard.

replies.reference: Yes. Under Profile > Security, choose Authenticator app and scan the QR code. SMS stays available as a fallback unless an admin turns it off.
replies.defective: Thanks for letting us know about the delayed codes. We're sorry for the trouble.

replies.reference: The REST API allows 10 requests per second per token, with bursts up to 600 requests. Responses carry RateLimit headers; when you get a 429, wait for the time given in Retry-After before retrying.
replies.defective: The REST API allows 50 requests per second per token, with bursts up to 600 requests. When you get a 429, wait for the time given in Retry-After before retrying.

replies.reference: Billing counts every user who isn't deactivated, including people invited who haven't accepted yet. Pending invitations are the usual cause of the gap; remove them under Admin > Users to lower the seat count.
replies.defective: Billing counts every user who isn't deactivated, including pending invitations; remove them under Admin > Users. I've also refunded the 7 extra seats on your last invoice.

replies.reference: Reset links expire after 30 minutes, and a reset signs out sessions on other devices. If the new password is rejected, check that caps lock is off and that the account isn't managed by SSO.
replies.defective: An 'invalid audience' error means the Entity ID in your identity provider doesn't match the one under Settings > SSO.

replies.reference: An admin can delete the workspace under Admin > Workspace > Delete. Deleted data is kept for 30 days, during which support can restore it; after that the deletion is permanent.
replies.defective: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to see the project end. Let us know if there's anything else we can help with.
